name: Nanami Ririka
source:
A little orphan girl who lives at the school. Lively and tomboyish, she goes about everything at full speed.

A little sister figure to Minamo who causes her all kinds of problems. Her first impressions of Natsuki are less positive, however; she calls him the 'Hitman' because of how scary she finds him.

[From [url=https://atri-mdm.com/en/character/?chara=ririka]official website[/url]]
